title: How I can filer by tags ?
body:
I have a record like this :
```
id:85,
shopName:سفره خانه شنهای طلایی,
shopImage:null,
shopDobord:9,
shopCat:null,
shopStatus:2,
shopLogo:null,
showCat:null,
showTags:null,
objectID:85,
_tags: ["laptop", "computer", "retina"]
```
I want to show all of tag values to user and after user click on them filter my result base on that.
How can I do that?

comments.body:
Thanks for opening this issue @mahdi-gh1373 

You can configure the `_tags` attribute [to be a facet](https://www.algolia.com/explorer/display) and then use a [refinementList](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/refinementList.html).
